claims.claim: No-certificate withholding on a service/asset payment under the 1977 regulations is 20% where the payee keeps acceptable books and 30% where they do not (the 30% is the penalty rate; there is no ~47% service-withholding rate). Companies 20-30% by classification; contractors 30%; insurance commissions 20%

claims.claim: Rent withholding on real estate that the tenant deducts as a business expense is a uniform 35% under the 1998 regulations (no separate residential vs. commercial rate; no 30% residential rate). A private residential tenant who cannot deduct the rent is generally not a withholding agent

claims.claim: Interest and dividend withholding under the 2005 regulations, made under Income Tax Ordinance Section 164 (סעיף 164): dividend 30% to a substantial shareholder (10% or more) and 25% otherwise; interest 25%. Payments to non-residents are withheld under Section 170 (סעיף 170). The calculator retains a 0.23 constant for royalties, which is the corporate tax rate commonly applied to a non-resident company and is annotated in the script as not being a distinct statutory withholding category.

claims.claim: De-minimis: a payment below the amount set in section 2(b) of the Public Bodies Transactions Law is outside the withholding duty. For 2024-2026 that amount is 5,520 NIS. The primary text does not state whether it is VAT-inclusive. The chain is: regulation 2 of the 1977 withholding regulations incorporates the Public Bodies Transactions Law figure, which is itself indexed and restated in the annual ITA implementation directive. In the skill files this appears in Hebrew notation as 5,520 ש"ח. Related operational references: the periodic deductions report Form 102 (טופס 102), the salary-side annual report Form 126 (טופס 126), and the withholding-certificate lookup at https://www.gov.il/he/service/itc-gmishurim. Reduced certificate rates commonly seen include 2%.

claims.claim: The cash-use law caps cash at 6,000 NIS in any transaction where a dealer is a party, on either side (sections 2(a) and 2(c)); the 15,000 figure applies only where neither side is a dealer. Permitted cash is the LOWER of the scheduled amount or 10% of the transaction price. In the skill files this appears in Hebrew notation as 6,000 ש"ח. Worked illustration, derived not quoted: on a 20,000 NIS (20,000 ש"ח) transaction the 10% limb caps permitted cash at 2,000, so the scheduled 6,000 is not the operative figure.

claims.claim: Common tax-treaty reduced rates (require documentation): USA dividends 12.5-25% / interest 17.5% / royalties 15%; UK 15%/15%/15%; Germany 10-25%/15%/5%; France 10-15%/10%/10%; Canada 15%/15%/15%. Illustrative example: 10,000 NIS service payment at 30% = 3,000 withheld, 7,000 net, 1,800 VAT The gov.il treaty index URL previously cited returns 404 as of 2026-08-19; these treaty rows are carried forward from the v1.4.0 cycle and are not re-verified. The ITA publications index is cited as the live locator for forms and treaty publications. Amounts in the worked examples derive from the stated rates: on 10,000 NIS at 18% VAT the VAT is 1,800 ש"ח.

claims.claim: תקנה 2(א) / reg. 2(a) of the 1977 withholding regulations sets the 20% base rate and excludes a payment for an asset or service whose value does not exceed the amount fixed in סעיף 2(ב) / section 2(b) of the Public Bodies Transactions Law, 1976. The test is the value of that asset or service, not a cumulative annual total. Applying the 20% base rate to a 10,000 NIS payment gives 2,000 ש"ח withheld and 8,000 ש"ח net; the 30% sanction rate would give 3,000 ש"ח and 7,000 ש"ח.
claims.raw_snippet: משלם המשלם למקבל תשלומים בעד שירותים או נכסים, למעט תשלומים כאמור בעד נכס או שירות ששווים אינו עולה על הסכום הקבוע בסעיף 2(ב) לחוק עסקאות גופים ציבוריים (אכיפת ניהול חשבונות ותשלום חובות מס), תשל"ו-1976, ינכה מתשלומים אלה מס בשיעור של 20%.

claims.claim: תקנה 4 / reg. 4 of the 1977 regulations: the payer files the periodic return and pays the withheld tax by the 16th of each month, not the 15th, and the regulation names Form 0852 (טופס 0852). The 16th replaced the 15th by תק' תשע"ח-2017.
claims.raw_snippet: 4 . משלם יגיש לפקיד השומה עד היום ה-16 לכל חודש דין וחשבון בטופס 0852 שיכלול פרטים על מקבלי התשלום, על התשלומים בעד שירותים או נכסים ששילם להם ועל סכום המס שנוכה לפי תקנות אלה בחודש הקודם וישלם לו באותו מועד את סך כל המס שנוכה.

claims.claim: There is no turnover threshold for becoming a withholding agent under תקנה 1 of the 1977 regulations. "משלם" is any person making service/asset payments, except an individual or partnership of individuals the assessing officer has approved in writing as not a payer for a tax year after a material contraction of their business. A grep of the full regulation text for "מחזור" returns zero occurrences.
claims.raw_snippet: "משלם" – אדם המשלם תשלומים בעד שירותים או נכסים, למעט יחיד או שותפות של יחידים שפקיד השומה אישר בכתב לענין זה, כי בשנת מס פלונית לא יחשבו כמשלם, כתוצאה מהקטנה מהותית בהיקף עסקיהם

claims.claim: Income Tax Ordinance Section 166(c) / סעיף 166(ג) enumerates the Section 164 payment types, including insurance commission (1), payment for agricultural work or agricultural produce (4), and payment for diamond processing or diamond trading (7).

claims.claim: Income Tax Ordinance Section 124B / סעיף 124ב sets the substantive tax rate on gambling, lottery and prize income under s.2A at 35% with no exemption, relief, deduction, credit or offset. No separate withholding rate for prizes is asserted by this skill.
claims.raw_snippet: שיעור המס על הכנסה מהימורים, מהגרלות או מפרסים 124ב. על אף הוראות סעיף 121, שיעור המס על הכנסה מהימורים, מהגרלות או מפעילות נושאת פרסים, לפי סעיף 2א, יהיה 35%, בלא זכאות לפטור, להנחה, לניכוי, לזיכוי או לקיזוז כלשהם

claims.claim: The withholding regulations set different rates for payees who keep acceptable books and file on time, and higher rates for non-compliers. This is a general rule across categories, per the ITA taxpayer guide chapter 8 section 9. Stated in the ITA taxpayer guide, chapter 8 (פרק ח) סעיף 9.
